topic: Matrix Multiplication as Composition of Linear Transformations

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: The Transformation View
lecture_lines: A matrix transforms a vector in space.
We can visualize this as grid morphing.
Consider a rotation matrix applied to coordinates.
animations: Create a 2D coordinate grid with thin white lines #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Write the matrix equation v' = Mv and highlight M #FFD700.
Show a vector v transitioning to v' using M #00FF00.

sections.title: The Concept of Composition
lecture_lines: Composition is applying two transformations in sequence.
It is the result of T2 after T1.
Think of it as moving a robot arm.
animations: Visualize two separate grid transformations T1 and T2 using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg] #FFFFFF.
Show vector v being moved by T1 then T2 #FFD700.
Show the final combined vector position result using an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/arm.svg] #00FF00.

sections.title: Bridging to Matrix Multiplication
lecture_lines: If T1 is A and T2 is B.
Then the composition is represented by BA.
This matrix BA combines both effects.
animations: Label Matrix A as transformation T1 #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Label Matrix B as transformation T2 #FFD700.
Show Matrix multiplication BA resulting in a combined matrix #00FF00 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing the 'Why': The Grid Perspective
lecture_lines: We see grid morphing with two matrices.
The final state matches the product BA.
Grid transformation visualizes matrix multiplication clearly.
animations: Morph the grid lines to match the product matrix BA #FFD700.
Highlight final grid coordinates in green [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] #00FF00.

sections.title: Summary & Order Sensitivity
lecture_lines: Socks then shoes differs from shoes then socks.
animations: Animate the sequence AB result #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/socks.svg].
Flash the grid lines where results differ #FF4500 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shoes.svg].
